data.title: Log Sanitizer - Masking Sensit
data.solution:
import sys
import re

n = int(input())

card_regex = r"\b\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}\b"
token_regex = r"(?<=\btoken=)[a-zA-Z0-9]+"

for _ in range(n):
    line = input()
    line = re.sub(card_regex, "[CARD_REDACTED]", line)
    line = re.sub(token_regex, "[TOKEN_REDACTED]", line)
    print(line)
data.statement:
As a SecOps engineer, you must ensure that sensitive data never leaks into application logs.

Inspect a stream of server log lines and sanitize any occurrence of the following patterns:

1. <<Credit Card Numbers:>> Four groups of 4 decimal digits separated by hyphens (`XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`). Replace the entire card number with `[CARD_REDACTED]`.
2. <<API Secret Tokens:>> Any parameter matching the case-sensitive prefix `token=` followed immediately by one or more alphanumeric characters (`token=[a-zA-Z0-9]+`). Replace only the secret value with `[TOKEN_REDACTED]`, resulting in `token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]`.

All other log characters must remain untouched.

Goal

As a SecOps engineer, you must ensure that sensitive data never leaks into application logs.

Inspect a stream of server log lines and sanitize any occurrence of the following patterns:

1. Credit Card Numbers: Four groups of 4 decimal digits separated by hyphens (
XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX
). Replace the entire card number with 
[CARD_REDACTED]
.
2. API Secret Tokens: Any parameter matching the case-sensitive prefix 
token=
followed immediately by one or more alphanumeric characters (
token=[a-zA-Z0-9]+
). Replace only the secret value with 
[TOKEN_REDACTED]
, resulting in 
token=[TOKEN_REDACTED]
.

All other log characters must remain untouched.
Input
Line 1: An integer N for the number of log lines.
Next N lines: A string representing a raw log entry.
Output
N lines: The sanitized log entries with all sensitive card numbers and tokens redacted.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 50
Each line contains between 1 and 250 printable ASCII characters.
Tokens are bounded by non-alphanumeric characters or the end of the line.
Example
Input
2
Payment processed with card 1234-5678-9012-3456 successfully.
GET /api/v1/user?token=abC123XyZ HTTP/1.1
Output
Payment processed with card [CARD_REDACTED] successfully.
GET /api/v1/user?token=[TOKEN_REDACTED] HTTP/1.1
